reason: AZZ sells galvanizing and coil coating as a service on customer-owned steel, plus coated coil. Perma-Pipe manufactures engineered pre-insulated piping, containment and leak detection systems for specific projects. Its anti-corrosion coating is applied to its own pipe and is not sold as a stand-alone coating service. End markets overlap only loosely (infrastructure and industrial). Buyers differ: AZZ sells to fabricators and coil users, Perma-Pipe to district energy, mechanical and pipeline contractors.
